title: Fix discovered issues from L4/L5 stress runs
description: Read stress-results-l4.json and stress-results-l5.json, address every entry in failed[] that is in-scope (hangs, state corruption, unhandled rejections, session isolation failures). Each fix lands in a small, scoped change with a corresponding test re-run to confirm green.
action: For each entry in stress-results-l4.json.failed[] and stress-results-l5.json.failed[]: (1) read the file_line + repro hint; (2) make the smallest patch that addresses the root cause (NOT a symptom suppress like try/catch swallow); (3) re-run the corresponding stress test, expect that single test to now pass; (4) update stress-results-l4.json (or l5) moving the entry from failed[] to passed[] and adding a `fix_commit` ref. Out-of-scope or M3-deferred items stay in failed[] and feed TASK-006. Common expected fixes: enforce timeout_per_role in level4-brainstorm.js generateArtifacts (line 273); make _appendSnapshotIndex atomic in session-manager.js:348 (use renameSync swap); guard concurrent persistState in level5-coordinator.js:573 with a per-session write lock or sequence number.

criteria: After fixes: cd src-tauri/bin/sidecar && npx vitest run workflow/levels/level4-brainstorm.stress.test.js exits 0 with all 4 tests passing OR remaining failures match stress-results-l4.json.failed[] (deferred to M3)
After fixes: cd src-tauri/bin/sidecar && npx vitest run workflow/levels/level5-coordinator.stress.test.js exits 0 with all 4 tests passing OR remaining failures match stress-results-l5.json.failed[]
Each fix has a corresponding entry in stress-results-l*.json.passed[] with `fix_commit` and `fix_summary` fields
No new ts-ignore, eslint-disable, or test.skip introduced (grep -rn 'test.skip\|@ts-ignore\|eslint-disable' src-tauri/bin/sidecar/workflow/ returns 0 new lines vs baseline)
convergence.definition_of_done: Every fixable failure is fixed; remaining failures are explicitly marked deferred with reason. Stress tests are green or have documented deferrals only.

files.change: Add timeout_per_role enforcement (Promise.race against setTimeout) and unhandled rejection containment around _analyzeAsRole calls
Replace read-modify-write with atomic write via temp file + renameSync, OR add per-session write queue
Address any concurrent-write or resume-replay bug surfaced by stress-results-l5.json (concrete fix depends on findings)

implementation: Read stress-results-l4.json and stress-results-l5.json. For each failed[] entry, classify: in-scope (fix now) vs out-of-scope (defer to TASK-006).
For each in-scope entry: write a single Edit per file targeting the root cause. Do NOT use ts-ignore, .skip, or empty catch. If a fix needs >50 lines, split into sub-tasks.
After each fix, re-run the corresponding test: `cd src-tauri/bin/sidecar && npx vitest run workflow/levels/level4-brainstorm.stress.test.js -t '<test name>'`. Expect green.
Move the entry from failed[] to passed[] in stress-results-l*.json. Add fields: fix_summary (1 sentence), fix_commit (will be set during commit phase).

Common fixes anticipated: (a) wrap each generateArtifacts iteration with Promise.race timeout; (b) atomic snapshot-index write via writeFileSync(tmp) + renameSync(tmp, target); (c) ensure persistState writes are awaited before next phase transition.
Stop after 3 attempts on the same failure — escalate to TASK-006 deferral.

unit: all stress tests must remain runnable
success_metrics: failed[].length decreases or remaining failures explicitly marked deferred

reference.pattern: Coding philosophy: Fix root cause, not symptoms. No suppression mechanisms.

rationale.chosen_approach: Iterate over failures from stress-results, fix smallest viable patch each, re-run test. Decoupling test execution (TASK-003/004) from fixes lets us see total failure surface before patching.
decision_factors: Avoids tunnel vision on first failure
rationale.tradeoffs: Wave-3 work is variable-length depending on how many failures stress runs surface.

risks: Fix may introduce new failure mode — re-run full stress suite after each fix, not just the targeted test
Some bugs may need cross-file changes (e.g., SessionManager + L5 coordinator) — keep atomic per concern
